svg.text: ⚠️ WHERE THE ANALOGY BREAKS DOWN: UNREPLICABLE PLANETARY PHYSICS
Essential Scientific Guardrails • Fundamental Environmental Disparities That Earth Cannot Replicate

g.text: 1. SURFACE GRAVITY DISPARITY
[PHYSICAL LIMIT]
Scientific Consequence: Rover tractive force, wheel sinkage in regolith, slope
stability, and human locomotion fatigue operate under completely different physics.
2. ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE & VACUUM
[PHYSICAL LIMIT]
Earth: 101.3 kPa (N₂/O₂) • Moon: <10⁻¹⁰ Pa (Vacuum) • Mars: 0.6 kPa (Thin CO₂)
Scientific Consequence: No aerodynamic drag on Moon; pure radiative thermal
cooling; liquid water boils and sublimates immediately on planetary surfaces.
3. COSMIC & SOLAR PARTICLE RADIATION
[PHYSICAL LIMIT]
Earth: ~2.4 mSv/yr (Protected) • Moon/Mars: 300 to 1,100 mSv/yr (Unshielded GCR+SPE)
Scientific Consequence: Rapid single-event electronic latchups; solar array
browning; lethal cumulative biological DNA damage for crewed operations.
4. REGOLITH SHARPNESS & PERCHLORATES
[MEASURED MISMATCH]
Earth: Weathered rounded sands • Moon/Mars: Sub-micron jagged glass + ClO₄⁻
Scientific Consequence: Extreme mechanical seal wear; electrostatic clinging;
toxic thyroid disruption from perchlorates; severe space suit fabric abrasion.

svg.text: TERRATWIN explicitly prohibits claiming environmental equivalence based solely on mathematical similarity scores.
Terrestrial analogues are valid exclusively for specific subsystem tests (e.g., rover chassis suspension, autonomous navigation,
drill torque, or UV sensor coating degradation). System-level mission architectures must incorporate testing under simulated
